goal_text: Find the bug in this Python function that is supposed to find the maximum value in an array. Identify the line number, bug category, and propose the exact fix.
ground_truth: Bug at line 4: 'if arr[i] < max_val:' should be 'if arr[i] > max_val:'. The condition is inverted — it updates max_val when a smaller value is found, making the function return the minimum instead of the maximum. Category: logic error. Fix: change '<' to '>'.
